note: Eleven keystone traces. Every trace is concept-local demo state and says so; nothing here masquerades as production wiring.

traces.validation_permission: formatter must be state=detected; nothing runs for not-found or disabled entries (honest failure receipt instead)
traces.mutation_or_operation: Shared trigger formatter-test: staged run phase, then lastTest = {when, ok, sample:{before, after}} on the entry
traces.receipt: Formatter test - Prettier formatted the sample. Before and after are shown on the row.
traces.ui_projection: Detail sheet re-renders the before/after sample panel; the list row note updates
traces.usage_attribution: none (local sample in a scratch buffer; project files never touched)

traces.validation_permission: server must exist and not be state=missing; restart consumes from the per-hour restart cap
traces.mutation_or_operation: Shared trigger lsp-restart: stopping then starting phases, lastRestart timestamp lands on the server
traces.receipt: Language server restarted - Rust reattached to its open documents.
traces.ui_projection: Op line on the detail sheet walks the phases; lastRestart sentence appears after settle

traces.validation_permission: name and command required (field-level errors otherwise); scope must be project|global
traces.mutation_or_operation: Push a custom entry into store.data.lsp: state=installed, health=stopped, startup='On first matching file', capabilities declared on first start
traces.receipt: Server added - registered and will start on the first matching file.
traces.ui_projection: List sheet gains the row with the Custom chip; detail offers Edit/Remove only for custom entries

demo_binding.interaction: Add a custom server form sheet; Save writes the live store

traces.validation_permission: name and endpoint required; transport defaults from extensions.mcp.default-transport
traces.mutation_or_operation: Push a server into store.data.mcp with health=added ('not connected yet'), empty tools, cache freshness none, approval once
traces.receipt: Server added - registered. Connect when the server is reachable; nothing has been discovered yet.
traces.ui_projection: List gains the honestly-unconnected row; the detail sheet opens with Connect available

demo_binding.interaction: Add a server form sheet; Save writes the live store and opens the detail

traces.validation_permission: any non-connected server; also driven by the fx.reconnect-required notice's primary action
traces.mutation_or_operation: Shared trigger reconnect (phases) then MCP-side settle: health=connected, reconnectRequired cleared, protocol negotiated, cache freshened, log line prepended
traces.receipt: Server reconnected - negotiated protocol and rediscovered its tools.
traces.ui_projection: Status word flips through Connecting to Connected; cache block reads fresh; the notice clears on the next scenario rebuild

demo_binding.interaction: Reconnect now on the detail sheet; note: the shared trigger resolves unmatched refs to the first provider, which briefly flips it refreshing-ready (documented limitation)

traces.validation_permission: none needed - the preview is a read-only local expansion
traces.mutation_or_operation: NONE. Parameter placeholders substitute sample values locally; NO agent dispatch, NO queue entry, NO execution. The sheet asserts this in its own copy and has no run button.
traces.receipt: Copied - the expanded line is on the clipboard. It has not been run.
traces.ui_projection: Expansion code block + working directory, environment, scope, and would-ask-first facts
traces.usage_attribution: none - asserting NO agent dispatch and NO usage attribution is the point of this trace

demo_binding.interaction: Preview (dry run) from the command editor sheet

traces.validation_permission: captured combo must include a non-modifier key; conflict check against the full shortcut map blocks apply until resolved
traces.mutation_or_operation: Recorder captures the combo (Escape cancels capture); Apply stores originalKeys once and writes the new keys
traces.receipt: Shortcut remapped - Search all settings is now Ctrl+Shift+K. Reset restores the default any time.
traces.ui_projection: Shortcut row shows the new keycaps plus a Reset action; the cheat sheet reflects the change

demo_binding.interaction: Remap opens the recorder sheet; keydown handler builds the combo and runs the live conflict check

traces.validation_permission: expert-exposure capabilities (persistent eval) route through the confirm sheet before the mutation lands; others apply directly
traces.mutation_or_operation: Write capability[column] = level on store.data.testingDebug.capabilities; inherit-global cells re-render their followed value
traces.receipt: Capability set - DAP debugger is now On for this project.
traces.ui_projection: The select cell holds the value; inherit-global cells show 'Following global: Auto'

demo_binding.interaction: Matrix ComboBox change; expert cells revert until the confirm sheet applies

traces.validation_permission: numeric bounds (size 9-24, line height 1-2, opacity 50-100); invalid input restores the previous value with a toast
traces.mutation_or_operation: Patch the profile in store.data.terminalProfiles; the live preview re-renders from the same object
traces.ui_projection: Live preview (font, colors, cursor, opacity) updates immediately; the ANSI strip and swatches stay in sync

demo_binding.interaction: Detail-sheet controls patch the profile and call drawPreview()

traces.validation_permission: ask-first policy: the update runs only from the explicit button; manual-only installations never offer it
traces.mutation_or_operation: Shared trigger install-update: updating, verifying (seven conditions), ready, done; version advances and a verified history entry is prepended
traces.receipt: Update installed - Codex CLI updated 1.19.3 to 1.20.1 and verified. Dependent routes refreshed.
traces.ui_projection: The card's op line walks the phases; status word settles at Up to date; history gains the verified entry

traces.validation_permission: same ask-first gate; offered as 'Try the update again' on the rolled-back copilot card
traces.mutation_or_operation: Shared trigger install-update-fail: updating, verifying, verification-failed (adapter handshake rejected), rolled-back; BOTH history entries are written
traces.receipt: Update rolled back - verification failed after a clean install, so the previous generation was restored. Both steps are in the history.
traces.ui_projection: Op line shows the failure reason; status word lands on Rolled back; history renders failed-then-rolled-back in order
